title: Trust Pack quick-onramp and negotiation-ready answer generator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise procurement and legal teams routinely request completed SIG/CAIQs and supporting evidence. Sales engineering spends hours assembling bespoke answers and evidence packs, which lengthens sales cycles and drives discounts. Goal: create a tiered 'Trust Pack' productized offering (Lite / Standard / Verified) plus a negotiation-ready answer generator that produces legal-ready snippets and an evidence checklist tailored to the customer profile. We will A/B test pricing and bundling to determine optimal crediting triggers and conversion uplift. The initiative should reduce time-to-first-signature, lower SE time spent per deal, and provide a clear add-on that scales with enterprise risk profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Define three Trust Pack SKUs (Lite, Standard, Verified) with itemized deliverables and pricing anchors
Build a backend pipeline to generate prefilled SIG/CAIQ answers and a one-page evidence checklist from a canonical answer library
Create a simple UI flow in Console for customers to request and purchase a Trust Pack (hosted + Dedicated + Private compatibility notes)
Instrument metrics: sales cycle days, avg SE hours per deal, conversion delta for deals exposed to Trust Pack, revenue per deal; dashboard available to Growth and Sales leads
Run a 6-week A/B experiment on 60 sales-qualified opportunities and evaluate statistically significant uplift or neutral impact
Legal and Security sign-off on answer templates and Verified evidence requirements
Operational runbook for fulfillment (automation + manual SE handoff) with SLA targets (48h auto-fulfill for Lite/Standard; 7 days for Verified)
Pricing experiment variants configured and ready for rollout in billing system

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Verified pack requires cryptographic signing and storage—longer infra lead time. Mitigation: Launch Lite/Standard without signed attestations and stagger Verified as phase 2 with explicit communication to sales.
Risk: Legal liability from canned answers. Mitigation: Include 'based on current controls and documentation' language and require customer acknowledgement for Verified attestations.
Risk: Pricing experiment may cannibalize paid Professional services. Mitigation: coordinate with Partnerships to align fulfillment and referral incentives.
metrics_and_experiment_plan: Primary metric: Days from SQA to signature (median) for deals in experiment vs control
Secondary metrics: SE hours logged per deal, % of deals purchasing Trust Pack, average deal NRR uplift
Experiment arms: (A) Control, (B) Free Lite credit offer, (C) Paid Lite at $X + Standard at $Y
Sample size: 60 SQA opportunities (20 per arm) over 6 weeks; power calc attached in Drive
Dashboard: Trust Pack experiment dashboard in Console -> Growth experiments (widget ticket ENG-20123)
fulfillment_playbook: Lite: auto-generate PDF answers and evidence checklist; immediate download link; no manual review
Standard: auto-generate + SE review within 48h; packaged evidence links and suggested contract language
Verified: Standard + Security vetting, signed attestation artifact stored in customer tenant (requires KMS/HSM), manual SE/legal handoff
notes: This ticket intentionally separates productized Trust Pack from bespoke PS offerings. Objective is to create a repeatable, monetizable onramp for security-conscious enterprises.
We will coordinate with Dedicated and Private product leads to ensure data residency notes are surfaced during purchase flow.
If the experiment shows significant uplift, follow-up will include a pricing ladder and embed Trust Pack upsell into billing checkout and enterprise quotes.
